verdicts.evidence: Preflight.jl:209-211 resolve_hats docstring: 'anchor is whether the hat runs at full strength...It is unrelated to the file#heading anchors of [Config.resolve_anchor](@ref).' Doctor.jl:257-259 carries a matching disambiguating comment. No other bare ambiguous use found.

GBGCodingTools.jl:16 (module docstring, read first): 'An **instrument** is one of four review procedures: check-docs, check-consistency, bug-hunt, audit-changes.' DocLints.jl, Gate.jl, Audit.jl, Rounds.jl now cross-ref [GBGCodingTools](@ref).

GBGCodingTools.jl:22-23 defines 'The gate, [gate](@ref)...'. DocLints.jl:17 and TestHarness.jl:583 both link [GBGCodingTools.gate](@ref) and distinguish it from their own local gate; CLI/Gate.jl:8 is the named home.

GBGCodingTools.jl:18 (read first): 'A **lane** is one agent's share of a round — one surface, one territory, or one kind of change.' Schema.jl:41-43 (first true use) restates it and links [GBGCodingTools](@ref).

GBGCodingTools.jl:20: 'A **hat** is one persona of the check-consistency panel, reading the corpus from a single standpoint.' Init.jl:233 links Preflight.resolve_hats; Preflight.jl:198 restates the defining sentence before its field list.
Reflection.jl:164: 'the [`GBGCodingTools.Ledger`](@ref)'s [exemption.match] predicate' — now an @ref link at first mention, per RULE.DOC.XLINK.

GBGCodingTools.jl:21: 'A **Workflow** is the instrument's workflow/*.js script, launched by the session running the round.' Schema.jl:41-42 restates it at first true use, linked to [GBGCodingTools](@ref).
